title: vanilla reimagined
description: This pack levels up the graphics while staying true to the Vanilla feel
body:
![a screenshot of game](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/818a4a320c8e00e9f3e18b0c97435ef7498f8863.png)**Vanilla Remagined**
This pack levels up the graphics while staying true to the Vanilla feel.

Experience Minecraft with enhanced visuals, smoother performance, and immersive details without losing the classic atmosphere you love.

✨ **Main Features**
Enhanced Graphics: Featuring Photon Shaders for a modern, realistic look.

Peak Performance: Optimized with Sodium and Lithium for the best FPS.

Vanilla+ Atmosphere: Subtle 3D models and improved animations.

Immersive Sound: Realistic audio physics and footsteps.
